name: Smishek Lake Campground
note: Campground on Game and Fish's Smishek Lake Wildlife Management Area, a small reservoir 4 miles north of Powers Lake: two gravel loops on open grass along the north-west shore, with a shelter, playground, swim beach and dock, fishing docks and a boat ramp. No fee or season is published; the county lists the City of Powers Lake's parks contact for availability, so call ahead. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: ND HHS Statewide Licensed RV Parks/Campgrounds (updated 07.17.2025) #356 'SMISHEK LAKE CAMPGROUND, Burke Co Rd 7, Powers Lake' / owner ND GAME & FISH DEPARTMENT / First District Health Unit / last inspected 8/21/2023 / 50 units; Burke County visitors page (burkecountynd.com/visitors, read 2026-11-12) 'Smishek Lake Campground: 30 primitive sites and 30 sites with electricity, 2 unloading docks, 2 fishing docks, and 1 swimming dock. Call for availability. (701) 705-5369'; ND G&F WMA listing (gf.nd.gov/wma-listing, read 2026-11-12) 'Smishek Lake, 4 miles north of Powers Lake ... Overnight camping prohibited Tuesdays and Wednesdays, except holidays' (202 acres); Esri imagery shows two gravel camping loops with a shelter, playground, toilet buildings, fire-ring pads along the west road and parked travel trailers; Google Maps 'Smishek Lake Recreation Area' 4.9 on 8 reviews (no phone) at 48.61275,-102.66806 -> designated, licensed state drive-in campground with electric sites, not a bare WMA allowance (public, no price gate)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: Esri World Imagery (360 m frame at 48.61375,-102.66551 and z19 tiles over the loops, shore and ramp) shows two gravel loops on open mown grass on Smishek Lake's north-west shore. The visible site markers (fire-ring pads and parked trailers) sit along the west road against a shelterbelt, ~55-170 m from the water across both loop roads; the east loop road runs ~25-35 m from the shore across open grass, but no pads or pedestals are visible there (one possible fire ring) and no site map exists, so no on-water site is proven. Water is visible across open, unscreened grass from the loops -> lakeview floor. Dam check: Smishek Lake Dam (NID ND00284, 48.60979,-102.66608) forms the south shore ~450 m S; the campground is on the reservoir side, DEM 685-687 m at the loops vs 683 m on the water (Open-Meteo).

booking.note: No camping on Tuesday or Wednesday nights except holidays, and all equipment must be removed those days (ND Game and Fish Wildlife Management Area rule).

booking_source: https://gf.nd.gov/wma ('The following WMAs are closed to camping on Tuesdays and Wednesdays except holidays, but open to camping Thursday-Monday: ... Smishek Lake and Short Creek Dam, Burke County ... all equipment must be removed on Tuesdays and Wednesdays'; 10-consecutive-day camping limit on any WMA) and https://gf.nd.gov/wma-listing, read 2026-11-12; https://www.burkecountynd.com/visitors ('Call for availability. (701) 705-5369'), read 2026-11-12

sites.note: 30 sites with electricity and 30 primitive sites (Burke County); the state licence counts 50 units. Amperage not published.

flags: Tuesday/Wednesday ban APPLIES: ND G&F lists Smishek Lake among WMAs closed to camping Tue/Wed nights except holidays, with all equipment removed those days (gf.nd.gov/wma, page dated August 2026). Carried in booking.note as AWH directed; same handling as 5951 McGregor Dam.

Licence holder: ND HHS list (07.17.2025) #356 names ND GAME & FISH DEPARTMENT as owner (50 units). The phone Burke County gives, 701-705-5369, is the City of Powers Lake parks contact (the city's Parks & Recreation page uses it for its own RV parks), so the city may run the campground day to day under an agreement. Stored ownership state on the licence and the WMA land; 5951 McGregor Dam and 6011 Short Creek (also G&F WMA ground) are stored local because a county runs them. Switch to local if AWH prefers the operator.

No fee, season or amperage found anywhere official: the city's Parks & Recreation page doesn't mention Smishek; fees, season and hookups left absent (unknown). Campendium's '20/30/50 amp, showers' and its 'Smishek Lake City Park' name are unsourced aggregator data, not used.
Booking left without reservable/fcfs: Campendium says no reservations / first-come first-served, but Burke County says 'Call for availability'; neither is authoritative enough to set the field.
Pin: Google's point (48.61275,-102.66806) sits ~200 m SW on the access road west of the boat-ramp lot; pinned to the camping loops (48.61368,-102.66567). Campendium's 48.613,-102.666 is by the ramp.
No existing entry by name or within 5 km (nearest DB entries: 5981 Powers Lake City Park ~6 km S). Not on RV Life.
No horse camping mentioned anywhere. ndtourism.com not used.
